serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Bot: Quickly! You: Wheeze! Why are we running?! Bot: We need to make it to the bus on time! You: Can’t we just take the next one? Bot: No! We will lose an hour of fun! Bot: We paid for the whole evening and we’re gonna get the whole evening! Bot: Besides, it’s your fault we are late. I didn’t consider your complaining in this date’s calculations!
